tools.description: Read one group, resource or note as the sample projection with its full Meta, plus the id and name of its carrier (category, resource category or note type).
tools.name: get_entity

tools.description: List entities related to one entity: up (owners), down (owned) or across (links). Returns at most 50 entries per page.
tools.name: list_related

kind.description: Only entries of this entity type.

tools.description: Read a carrier's saved template slots, MetaSchema and SectionConfig. Name fields to read only those.
tools.name: get_template

tools.description: Find carriers (categories, resource categories or note types) by name. Returns id, name and description, at most 50 per page.
tools.name: list_carriers

tools.description: List the entities that use a carrier, newest first, as type, id and name. At most 50 per page.
tools.name: list_members

tools.description: List a carrier's template revisions, newest first, with more=true when another page exists. Defaults to the carrier being edited. Needs edit rights to that carrier.
tools.name: list_revisions

tools.description: Read one template revision by number, optionally one field of it. Defaults to the carrier being edited. Needs edit rights to that carrier.
tools.name: get_revision

field.description: A template field name, e.g. CustomHeader, CustomCSS or MetaSchema.

tools.description: Diff two template revisions, grouped by slot. 'to' defaults to the newest. Defaults to the carrier being edited. Needs edit rights to that carrier.
tools.name: diff_revisions

tools.description: Lint a template field (or a MetaSchema) and return its issues. Omit content to lint your latest submission, else the editor value.
tools.name: lint

field.description: A template field name, e.g. CustomHeader, CustomCSS or MetaSchema.

tools.description: Check an MRQL query statically without running it, optionally with parameters, a row limit and bucket count.
tools.name: check_mrql

tools.description: Render a template field against a real entity and return the HTML text and CSS text. Omit content or css to use your latest submission, else the editor value.
tools.name: preview

field.description: A template field name, e.g. CustomHeader, CustomCSS or MetaSchema.

tools.description: Read a template partial's description and source by name.
tools.name: get_partial

tools.description: Read the full documentation entry of a built-in or plugin shortcode by name.
tools.name: get_shortcode_docs

tools.description: Submit a draft: a map of field name to content, with an optional explanation. Each field is linted and the result returned. The last submission of each field is kept. Submit early and in parts. Set done=true when finished.
tools.name: submit
